title: Castle Clinton
visualBrief: Current hollow D-shaped varied brownstone fort with thick separate outer wall, real front/rear passageways and28 interpreted barred gunports, broad gray-shingle covered perimeter walks, curved brick-pier porch and straight pale-wood colonnade/restored quarters. Filled upper gateway arch, rusticated four-pilaster surround, layered cornice/two chimneys and two dark polygonal wood kiosks. Open courtyard and mapped roof opening remain distinct from wall thickness; no aquarium dome.
